author_context.author: James Chang; machine proof owner author readback
author_context.paragraph: Conditional PR1094 source context: kappa = 836330098538459/500000000000000000 = 0.001672660197076918. This package proves reusable finite-word in-place Boolean XOR machines, exact sequential transition counts and tape footprints. It does not prove that conditional construction, a multiplication exponent, or a selected physical executor.

research_dependency: Only MarkedBitXorScan imports PairedBitXorScan; no other research source/object is required.
claims: For any finite paired bit list, the boundary-aware zipper reaches its first halt after5n+2 transitions, preserves source bits and returns its head/clean scratch.
An explicit seven-symbol marked tape removes boundary observation and reaches first halt after5n+4 transitions, including actual marker/head handling.
Every marked-machine prefix occupies exactlyn+2 cells, including both markers.
The output decodes to Nat XOR; the accepted algebra is reused.
limits: The input paired representation and marker installation are caller work; no free padding or arbitrary allocation is implied.
Cost unit is a finite-alphabet local transition. Another machine/gate representation may require a separate constant-factor refinement.
Scratch starts in a specified finite control state; no arbitrary dirty-output/whole-program reversible multiplication theorem is claimed.
Selected Cell/address/chart/executor correspondence remains outside this package.

attribution.imported_core: Lean core List and Nat bitwise APIs, retaining upstream authors/copyright including Lean FRO and Joe Hendrix. Core source/runtime are not copied into the proposed package.

assembly_boundary: Reuse these exact existing sources/evidence and normal author/NOTICE text. No archive, compiler rerun, CI preflight, upload, push or PR was performed for this manifest. Root/integration retains publication authority.
